# main

Aggregation root for the transfer pack. Holds the five high-signal handoff
documents and the branch maps. Every other branch is a satellite of this one.
Read `MACBOOK_AGENT_HANDOFF_MASTER.md` first, then `SYSTEM_GRAPH.md`.

## Why this matters

This is the entry point. Every other branch is a satellite. If an agent reads exactly one file, it should be `MACBOOK_AGENT_HANDOFF_MASTER.md`; if it reads two, the second is `SYSTEM_GRAPH.md`.

## What lives here

- Five high-signal handoff docs (`01-…` through `05-…`)
- The `SYSTEM_GRAPH.md` rendered overview
- The `AGENT_TRAVERSAL.md` traversal guide
- The `AGENT_BOOTSTRAP.md` fresh-machine setup
- `graph/` (schema, nodes, edges)
- `scripts/probe.sh` and `scripts/check-graph.sh`

## Where it connects

- All 35 other branches via `graph/nodes/<branch>.qmd`
- The original VM repos via `lineage-index/inventory/LOCAL_ROOTS.md`
- The original GitHub repos via `lineage-index/inventory/GITHUB_REPOS.md`

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TrajanWJ/ema-transfer-pack-20260422-060938.git
cd ema-transfer-pack-20260422-060938 && git fetch --all
./scripts/probe.sh
```
